workerClockSource: Authenticated real ServiceEvent.result.timings captured from the worker stream; main does not emit INFERENCE_METRIC. No inference from application wall time.
performanceInterpretation: Successful application coverage required for adoption; diagnostic worker rate includes ALL measured model requests, including generated tokens rejected by the API. It does not repair or remove failed tasks.
ttftBoundary: Observer HTTP client send-to-first valid text/tool-call output; Pi-to-observer dispatch is outside this interval.

official.method: Official HumanEval test field against complete solution.py files; one offline restricted Docker container per task

resourceGateNote: Response allocations are samples; candidate traces additionally cover tracked allocation/submission boundaries, not a continuous Metal-driver peak. Missing required peak evidence prevents adoption.
